mapper.insert:
insert into ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card (card_num, total_price, password, statut, use_name, creat_time, card_desc) values
(#{item.cardNum}, #{item.totalPrice}, #{item.password}, #{item.statut}, #{item.useName}, #{item.creatTime}, #{item.cardDesc})
mapper.select: SELECT card_num AS card_code, `password` AS card_password, id AS card_id, creat_time AS card_fetch_time, '0' AS card_media_id, '13962' AS server_id, '0' AS user_id, '' AS user_account, '0000-00-00 00:00:00' AS card_time, total_price AS card_money, '0.00' AS card_froze_money FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card WHERE id BETWEEN #{startCard} and #{finishCard}
